name: the all-new bundle of the loop-1 charter (parallel stub -> evaluator || generator || contract-persona; properties as frozen tests; blind generation width 2 with compile self-check and Opus escalation; Sonnet-default routing; retrieval excluding test fingerprints; contract-stage personas; gate addition G8; no output persona stage)

S.what: stub (interface, assumption, question, consequence tier; Sonnet low) -> contract-stage persona check (two personas; one fold-in revision of the stub) -> blind evaluator (contract, properties.md, 6-14 tests incl. property instances; Sonnet default); frozen by hash before any kernel is evaluated

G.what: two independent blind candidates (request + stub + contract, tests withheld; Sonnet default), compile self-check (one fix on diagnostics), G1-G7 on each, first passing candidate selected; if none passes, one Opus-default escalation with gate feedback on the best failed candidate

Q.what: G1-G7 (byte-identical) plus G8: every range the glue states as a leading bound or interval is enforced by a trap (lib/gate8.mjs)

R.what: no output persona stage: promotion = gated; the contract-stage persona in S-new is the review (D-03: the review moves before the build; D-02: its change is folded in, not shipped as a to-do)

retrieval: fingerprint over the 19 loop-0 development artefacts only (lib/retrieval.mjs; Jaccard >= 0.2 and a shared domain term); the hit's request, interface, assumption and kernel are shown to the stub and the generator; working and sealed fingerprints are never indexed
promotion: promoted = gated (G1-G7 and G8); a stub with serviceable:false is 'rejected' by design
screenCorners: S x G generated (4 artefacts per request: old/old = incumbent run; new/new; new/old = sequential generator on the blind evaluator's spec; old/new = blind generator on the incumbent's contract with its tests withheld); Q and R applied as post-hoc filters, so all 16 corners are read from the 4 artefacts
